entries.vietlish: he study English for three years already
entries.natural: he has studied English for three years
entries.sourcePattern: hoc tieng Anh ba nam roi -> duration with already, no present perfect
entries.context: He study English for three years already but is still shy to speak.

entries.vietlish: I am go to the market now
entries.natural: I am going to the market now
entries.sourcePattern: dang di cho -> progressive marker with a base verb
entries.context: I am go to the market now, do you need anything?

entries.vietlish: she cooked dinner when I come home
entries.natural: she was cooking dinner when I came home
entries.sourcePattern: khi toi ve -> present in the time clause for a past event
entries.context: She cooked dinner when I come home from work yesterday.

entries.vietlish: I living here for two years
entries.natural: I have been living here for two years
entries.sourcePattern: song o day hai nam -> missing auxiliary in present perfect continuous
entries.context: I living here for two years and I like the neighborhood.

entries.vietlish: yesterday is very hot
entries.natural: yesterday was very hot
entries.sourcePattern: hom qua nong lam -> copula not marked for past
entries.context: Yesterday is very hot, I could not sleep at night.

entries.vietlish: I am waiting for him since morning
entries.natural: I have been waiting for him since morning
entries.sourcePattern: doi tu sang -> present continuous for present perfect continuous
entries.context: I am waiting for him since morning but he never showed up.

entries.vietlish: the shop close already, come tomorrow
entries.natural: the shop is closed already, come tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: dong cua roi -> adjective state without be
entries.context: Sorry, the shop close already, come tomorrow at nine.

entries.vietlish: he go out just now
entries.natural: he just went out
entries.sourcePattern: vua moi ra ngoai -> time phrase placed at the end, no past
entries.context: He go out just now, maybe you can catch him outside.

entries.vietlish: I am knowing the answer
entries.natural: I know the answer
entries.sourcePattern: dang biet -> stative verb forced into the progressive
entries.context: Ask me, I am knowing the answer to this question.

entries.vietlish: she is having a car
entries.natural: she has a car
entries.sourcePattern: dang co xe -> stative have forced into the progressive
entries.context: She is having a car, so she can drive us there.

entries.vietlish: do you have finished
entries.natural: have you finished
entries.sourcePattern: ban xong chua -> do-support added to a perfect question
entries.context: Do you have finished your report for the meeting?

entries.vietlish: I have ate lunch
entries.natural: I have eaten lunch
entries.sourcePattern: an com roi -> wrong participle form of eat
entries.context: I have ate lunch, so I am not hungry now.

entries.vietlish: he has many money
entries.natural: he has a lot of money
entries.sourcePattern: nhieu tien -> many with uncountable money
entries.context: He has many money but he is not generous.

entries.vietlish: I want a coffee and two cake
entries.natural: I want a coffee and two cakes
entries.sourcePattern: hai cai banh -> count noun cake without plural
entries.context: I want a coffee and two cake, please.

entries.vietlish: there is a lot of student in the library
entries.natural: there are a lot of students in the library
entries.sourcePattern: nhieu sinh vien -> no plural and no number agreement
entries.context: There is a lot of student in the library before the exam.

entries.vietlish: she gave me an useful advice
entries.natural: she gave me useful advice
entries.sourcePattern: mot loi khuyen huu ich -> advice countable with article
entries.context: She gave me an useful advice about my career.

entries.vietlish: we saw many beautiful scenery
entries.natural: we saw a lot of beautiful scenery
entries.sourcePattern: nhieu canh dep -> scenery treated as countable many
entries.context: On the trip we saw many beautiful scenery in the mountains.

entries.vietlish: I have a homeworks to do
entries.natural: I have homework to do
entries.sourcePattern: bai tap ve nha -> article plus plural on uncountable homework
entries.context: I cannot go out, I have a homeworks to do tonight.

entries.vietlish: two kilo of rice please
entries.natural: two kilos of rice please
entries.sourcePattern: hai can gao -> unit kilo without plural
entries.context: Give me two kilo of rice please, the fragrant one.

entries.vietlish: he ate three bowl of pho
entries.natural: he ate three bowls of pho
entries.sourcePattern: ba to pho -> classifier bowl without plural
entries.context: He was so hungry, he ate three bowl of pho.

entries.vietlish: my class has forty student
entries.natural: my class has forty students
entries.sourcePattern: bon muoi hoc sinh -> student without plural after a number
entries.context: My class has forty student, it is very crowded.

entries.vietlish: she bought a new clothes
entries.natural: she bought new clothes
entries.sourcePattern: quan ao moi -> article before plural-only clothes
entries.context: For Tet she bought a new clothes for the children.

entries.vietlish: the news are not good today
entries.natural: the news is not good today
entries.sourcePattern: tin tuc -> news treated as plural for agreement
entries.context: The news are not good today, the market went down.

entries.vietlish: I need a scissor
entries.natural: I need scissors
entries.sourcePattern: cai keo -> scissors treated as singular with article
entries.context: To cut this paper I need a scissor.

entries.vietlish: give me some advice please
entries.natural: give me some advice please
entries.sourcePattern: cho toi loi khuyen -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for register check
entries.context: I don't know what to choose, give me some advice please.

entries.vietlish: the test tomorrow very important
entries.natural: the test tomorrow is very important
entries.sourcePattern: bai kiem tra ngay mai rat quan trong -> no copula before important
entries.context: The test tomorrow very important, I must study tonight.

entries.vietlish: my parents very proud of me
entries.natural: my parents are very proud of me
entries.sourcePattern: bo me rat tu hao -> copula dropped before adjective
entries.context: When I graduated, my parents very proud of me.

entries.vietlish: this soup too hot to eat
entries.natural: this soup is too hot to eat
entries.sourcePattern: canh nay nong qua -> copula dropped in too...to structure
entries.context: Wait a little, this soup too hot to eat now.

entries.vietlish: he not at home now
entries.natural: he is not at home now
entries.sourcePattern: anh ay khong co nha -> negative without copula
entries.context: Please call later, he not at home now.

entries.vietlish: they always late for class
entries.natural: they are always late for class
entries.sourcePattern: luc nao cung tre -> copula dropped before late
entries.context: Those two boys they always late for class.

entries.vietlish: the keys on the table
entries.natural: the keys are on the table
entries.sourcePattern: chia khoa o tren ban -> locative without be
entries.context: Don't worry, the keys on the table near the door.

entries.vietlish: she is can swim very well
entries.natural: she can swim very well
entries.sourcePattern: co the boi -> be inserted before a modal
entries.context: She is can swim very well, she trains every day.

entries.vietlish: I am must finish today
entries.natural: I must finish today
entries.sourcePattern: phai xong -> be inserted before must
entries.context: Sorry, I cannot go out, I am must finish today.

entries.vietlish: I am proud about my country
entries.natural: I am proud of my country
entries.sourcePattern: tu hao ve -> ve maps to about instead of of
entries.context: I am proud about my country and its history.

entries.vietlish: he is married since five years
entries.natural: he has been married for five years
entries.sourcePattern: cuoi nam nam roi -> since/for plus no present perfect
entries.context: He is married since five years and has one son.

entries.vietlish: I will see you on the morning
entries.natural: I will see you in the morning
entries.sourcePattern: vao buoi sang -> on for in with part of day
entries.context: Good night, I will see you on the morning.

entries.vietlish: we met in the bus stop
entries.natural: we met at the bus stop
entries.sourcePattern: o tram xe buyt -> in for at with a point location
entries.context: By chance we met in the bus stop this morning.

entries.vietlish: she is good for cooking
entries.natural: she is good at cooking
entries.sourcePattern: gioi nau an -> for instead of at after good
entries.context: My aunt she is good for cooking traditional food.

entries.vietlish: put your name in the top of the page
entries.natural: put your name at the top of the page
entries.sourcePattern: o tren cung -> in for at with top
entries.context: Please put your name in the top of the page before you start.

entries.vietlish: we arrived at home at midnight
entries.natural: we arrived home at midnight
entries.sourcePattern: ve den nha -> home over-marked with at
entries.context: The train was late, so we arrived at home at midnight.

entries.vietlish: I dream about become a doctor
entries.natural: I dream of becoming a doctor
entries.sourcePattern: mo uoc tro thanh -> about + base verb instead of of + gerund
entries.context: Since I was small I dream about become a doctor.

entries.vietlish: thank you about the gift
entries.natural: thank you for the gift
entries.sourcePattern: cam on ve mon qua -> ve maps to about instead of for
entries.context: Thank you about the gift, I really like it.

entries.vietlish: I am responsible of this project
entries.natural: I am responsible for this project
entries.sourcePattern: chiu trach nhiem ve -> of instead of for after responsible
entries.context: Please ask me, I am responsible of this project.

entries.vietlish: she apologized for be late
entries.natural: she apologized for being late
entries.sourcePattern: xin loi vi den tre -> for + base verb instead of gerund
entries.context: She apologized for be late to the meeting.

entries.vietlish: he succeeded to pass the exam
entries.natural: he succeeded in passing the exam
entries.sourcePattern: thanh cong vuot qua -> to-infinitive instead of in + gerund
entries.context: After studying hard, he succeeded to pass the exam.

entries.vietlish: I want to drink soup
entries.natural: I want to have some soup
entries.sourcePattern: uong canh -> drink collocated with soup
entries.context: I am not very hungry, I want to drink soup only.

entries.vietlish: she eats noodle with chopstick
entries.natural: she eats noodles with chopsticks
entries.sourcePattern: an mi bang dua -> noodle and chopstick without plural
entries.context: She eats noodle with chopstick very skillfully.

entries.vietlish: I will bring you to the hospital
entries.natural: I will take you to the hospital
entries.sourcePattern: dua di benh vien -> dua covers bring and take
entries.context: You look pale, I will bring you to the hospital now.

entries.vietlish: can you bring me to the airport tomorrow
entries.natural: can you take me to the airport tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: dua ra san bay -> dua = bring/take overgeneralized
entries.context: My flight is early, can you bring me to the airport tomorrow?

entries.vietlish: I go cut hair at the new shop
entries.natural: I'm going to get a haircut at the new shop
entries.sourcePattern: di cat toc -> di + activity calque plus cut hair
entries.context: This afternoon I go cut hair at the new shop near the market.

entries.vietlish: she wears a ring on her hand
entries.natural: she wears a ring on her finger
entries.sourcePattern: deo nhan o tay -> tay = hand/arm covers finger too
entries.context: She wears a ring on her hand, maybe she is engaged.

entries.vietlish: he drives a bicycle to school
entries.natural: he rides a bicycle to school
entries.sourcePattern: di xe dap -> drive for ride with a bicycle
entries.context: He drives a bicycle to school every morning.

entries.vietlish: she rides a car to work
entries.natural: she drives a car to work
entries.sourcePattern: di o to -> ride for drive with a car
entries.context: She rides a car to work because the office is far.

entries.vietlish: please help me to take down the box
entries.natural: please help me get the box down
entries.sourcePattern: lay xuong giup -> take down calqued plus extra to
entries.context: The shelf is high, please help me to take down the box.

entries.vietlish: I want to learn drive car
entries.natural: I want to learn to drive
entries.sourcePattern: hoc lai xe -> base verb plus redundant object
entries.context: Next month I want to learn drive car to go to work.

entries.vietlish: she takes a photo of the food before eat
entries.natural: she takes a photo of the food before eating
entries.sourcePattern: truoc khi an -> before + base verb instead of gerund
entries.context: She takes a photo of the food before eat, every time.

entries.vietlish: I make a dream last night
entries.natural: I had a dream last night
entries.sourcePattern: nam mo -> make collocated with dream, past dropped
entries.context: I make a dream last night that I missed my flight.

entries.vietlish: she did a party for her son
entries.natural: she threw a party for her son
entries.sourcePattern: to chuc tiec -> do/make for throw with party
entries.context: She did a party for her son's first birthday.

entries.vietlish: let me take a note of your number
entries.natural: let me make a note of your number
entries.sourcePattern: ghi lai -> take collocated with note instead of make
entries.context: One moment, let me take a note of your number.

entries.vietlish: he made a goal in the last minute
entries.natural: he scored a goal in the last minute
entries.sourcePattern: ghi ban -> make for score with goal
entries.context: He made a goal in the last minute and we won.

entries.vietlish: I do a nap in the afternoon
entries.natural: I take a nap in the afternoon
entries.sourcePattern: ngu trua -> do collocated with nap instead of take
entries.context: After lunch I do a nap in the afternoon for half an hour.

entries.vietlish: we make a queue to buy ticket
entries.natural: we line up to buy tickets
entries.sourcePattern: xep hang -> make a queue plus ticket without plural
entries.context: At the cinema we make a queue to buy ticket.

entries.vietlish: I want to make friend with you
entries.natural: I want to be friends with you
entries.sourcePattern: ket ban voi -> make friend singular for be friends
entries.context: You seem nice, I want to make friend with you.

entries.vietlish: she takes care the baby very well
entries.natural: she takes care of the baby very well
entries.sourcePattern: cham soc em be -> of dropped after take care
entries.context: The nanny is good, she takes care the baby very well.

entries.vietlish: what is your favorite food Vietnamese
entries.natural: what is your favorite Vietnamese food
entries.sourcePattern: mon an Viet Nam -> nationality adjective placed after the noun
entries.context: What is your favorite food Vietnamese, pho or banh mi?

entries.vietlish: do you know what time is it now
entries.natural: do you know what time it is now
entries.sourcePattern: bay gio may gio -> inversion kept in the embedded clause
entries.context: Excuse me, do you know what time is it now?

entries.vietlish: tell me why are you sad
entries.natural: tell me why you are sad
entries.sourcePattern: tai sao buon -> inversion kept after tell me
entries.context: You can trust me, tell me why are you sad.

entries.vietlish: I want to know how much does it cost
entries.natural: I want to know how much it costs
entries.sourcePattern: gia bao nhieu -> do-support kept in the embedded clause
entries.context: Before I decide, I want to know how much does it cost.

entries.vietlish: she asked me where do I live
entries.natural: she asked me where I live
entries.sourcePattern: hoi toi song o dau -> inversion kept in reported speech
entries.context: At the party she asked me where do I live.

entries.vietlish: always he forgets his keys
entries.natural: he always forgets his keys
entries.sourcePattern: luc nao cung -> frequency adverb fronted before the subject
entries.context: Always he forgets his keys at the office.

entries.vietlish: I both like coffee and tea
entries.natural: I like both coffee and tea
entries.sourcePattern: ca...lan -> both placed before the verb
entries.context: In the morning I both like coffee and tea.

entries.vietlish: yesterday what did you do
entries.natural: what did you do yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: hom qua ban lam gi -> time word fronted before the wh-word
entries.context: Yesterday what did you do after class?

entries.vietlish: you want which one
entries.natural: which one do you want
entries.sourcePattern: ban muon cai nao -> wh-word kept in situ at the end
entries.context: There are two sizes, you want which one?

entries.vietlish: teacher, can I go to toilet
entries.natural: Teacher, may I go to the toilet
entries.sourcePattern: thua co cho em di -> title address plus article dropped
entries.context: Teacher, can I go to toilet for a minute?

entries.vietlish: boss, I want to ask for leave tomorrow
entries.natural: I'd like to request leave tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: sep oi xin nghi -> title address plus xin = ask for
entries.context: Boss, I want to ask for leave tomorrow for a family matter.

entries.vietlish: uncle, how much is this
entries.natural: excuse me, how much is this
entries.sourcePattern: chu oi bao nhieu -> kinship term used to address a stranger
entries.context: Uncle, how much is this watermelon?

entries.vietlish: you are welcome, no need thank
entries.natural: you're welcome, no need to thank me
entries.sourcePattern: khong can cam on -> no need + base verb, dropped object
entries.context: It was nothing, you are welcome, no need thank.

entries.vietlish: please understand for me
entries.natural: please understand my situation
entries.sourcePattern: thong cam cho toi -> understand for me as a fixed plea
entries.context: I cannot pay this month, please understand for me.

entries.vietlish: eat more, don't be shy
entries.natural: help yourself to more, don't be shy
entries.sourcePattern: an nhieu vao dung ngai -> host's invitation calque
entries.context: There is plenty of food, eat more, don't be shy.

entries.vietlish: I take my leave first
entries.natural: I'll head off first
entries.sourcePattern: xin phep ve truoc -> formal leave-taking calque
entries.context: It is getting late, I take my leave first, see you tomorrow.

entries.vietlish: have you eaten rice yet
entries.natural: have you eaten yet
entries.sourcePattern: an com chua -> rice added to a greeting about eating
entries.context: Hello! Have you eaten rice yet? Come in and sit.

entries.vietlish: I am very confident to pass
entries.natural: I'm confident I'll pass
entries.sourcePattern: tu tin se do -> to-infinitive instead of a that-clause
entries.context: I studied a lot, I am very confident to pass the exam.

entries.vietlish: she eats for two persons
entries.natural: she eats for two people
entries.sourcePattern: an cho hai nguoi -> person pluralized as persons
entries.context: She is pregnant now, she eats for two persons.

entries.vietlish: this shirt is very fit to me
entries.natural: this shirt fits me very well
entries.sourcePattern: vua voi toi -> be + fit as adjective plus to instead of object
entries.context: I will buy it, this shirt is very fit to me.

entries.vietlish: the price is reasonable, I am satisfy
entries.natural: the price is reasonable, I'm satisfied
entries.sourcePattern: hai long -> satisfy without -ed participle for the experiencer
entries.context: The price is reasonable, I am satisfy with the deal.

entries.vietlish: the homework is very confusing, I am confusing
entries.natural: the homework is very confusing, I'm confused
entries.sourcePattern: boi roi -> -ing participle used for the affected person
entries.context: The homework is very confusing, I am confusing about question three.

entries.vietlish: she is sensible to the cold
entries.natural: she is sensitive to the cold
entries.sourcePattern: nhay cam -> sensible borrowed for sensitive
entries.context: Bring a jacket for her, she is sensible to the cold.

entries.vietlish: the movie is very touching, I am touching
entries.natural: the movie is very touching, I'm touched
entries.sourcePattern: cam dong -> -ing participle used for the experiencer
entries.context: The movie is very touching, I am touching at the ending.

entries.vietlish: my hand is paining
entries.natural: my hand hurts
entries.sourcePattern: tay dau -> pain used as a verb in the progressive
entries.context: After lifting boxes, my hand is paining a lot.

entries.vietlish: I am tired of waiting, very tiring
entries.natural: I'm tired of waiting, it's very tiring
entries.sourcePattern: met moi -> dropped dummy subject and be before tiring
entries.context: Two hours at the clinic, I am tired of waiting, very tiring.

entries.vietlish: this is more cheaper than online
entries.natural: this is cheaper than online
entries.sourcePattern: re hon -> more added to a comparative
entries.context: Buy at the shop, this is more cheaper than online.

entries.vietlish: she is older than me two years
entries.natural: she is two years older than me
entries.sourcePattern: lon hon toi hai tuoi -> measure phrase placed after the comparison
entries.context: My sister she is older than me two years.

entries.vietlish: he is the most tallest in the team
entries.natural: he is the tallest on the team
entries.sourcePattern: cao nhat -> most added to a superlative plus in for on
entries.context: He plays center because he is the most tallest in the team.

entries.vietlish: today I am more happy than yesterday
entries.natural: today I am happier than yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: vui hon -> more + short adjective instead of -er
entries.context: I got good news, today I am more happy than yesterday.

entries.vietlish: she has so many money but not happy
entries.natural: she has so much money but isn't happy
entries.sourcePattern: nhieu tien -> many with uncountable money plus dropped be
entries.context: She has so many money but not happy with her life.

entries.vietlish: this bag is as the same as that one
entries.natural: this bag is the same as that one
entries.sourcePattern: giong nhu -> as inserted before the same
entries.context: Don't buy two, this bag is as the same as that one.

entries.vietlish: I have less friends than before
entries.natural: I have fewer friends than before
entries.sourcePattern: it ban hon -> it covers less/fewer for count nouns
entries.context: Since I moved, I have less friends than before.

entries.vietlish: there were not many peoples at the party
entries.natural: there weren't many people at the party
entries.sourcePattern: khong nhieu nguoi -> people pluralized as peoples
entries.context: It was quiet, there were not many peoples at the party.

entries.vietlish: he earns double than me
entries.natural: he earns double what I earn
entries.sourcePattern: gap doi toi -> than instead of what after double
entries.context: In the new job he earns double than me.

entries.vietlish: raining outside, take umbrella
entries.natural: it's raining outside, take an umbrella
entries.sourcePattern: troi mua -> dummy subject it and article dropped
entries.context: Be careful, raining outside, take umbrella with you.

entries.vietlish: have a call for you
entries.natural: there's a call for you
entries.sourcePattern: co dien thoai -> co = have/there is existential transfer
entries.context: Pick up the phone, have a call for you from the office.

entries.vietlish: in the fridge have some fruit
entries.natural: there's some fruit in the fridge
entries.sourcePattern: trong tu lanh co -> co existential plus location fronted
entries.context: If you are hungry, in the fridge have some fruit.

entries.vietlish: this restaurant, the food very good but expensive
entries.natural: at this restaurant, the food is very good but expensive
entries.sourcePattern: nha hang nay, do an ngon -> topic fronting plus dropped be
entries.context: This restaurant, the food very good but expensive for me.

entries.vietlish: my old school, I miss it very much
entries.natural: I miss my old school very much
entries.sourcePattern: truong cu cua toi -> topic NP fronted with resumptive it
entries.context: My old school, I miss it very much since I graduated.

entries.vietlish: because too tired, I sleep early
entries.natural: because I was too tired, I slept early
entries.sourcePattern: vi qua met -> subject and be dropped in the because clause
entries.context: Last night, because too tired, I sleep early.

entries.vietlish: although poor but they are happy
entries.natural: although they are poor, they are happy
entries.sourcePattern: tuy ngheo nhung -> although...but paired plus dropped subject
entries.context: Although poor but they are happy together.

entries.vietlish: he not only lazy but also rude
entries.natural: he is not only lazy but also rude
entries.sourcePattern: khong nhung...ma con -> copula dropped in the correlative
entries.context: Nobody likes him, he not only lazy but also rude.

entries.vietlish: if you free, come to my house
entries.natural: if you're free, come to my house
entries.sourcePattern: neu ban ranh -> copula dropped in the if-clause
entries.context: This weekend if you free, come to my house for dinner.

entries.vietlish: no money, cannot buy
entries.natural: I have no money, so I can't buy it
entries.sourcePattern: khong tien, khong mua duoc -> subject and connector dropped
entries.context: I want that phone but no money, cannot buy now.

entries.vietlish: my internet is very slow today, cannot watch video
entries.natural: my internet is very slow today, I can't watch videos
entries.sourcePattern: khong xem video duoc -> dropped subject plus video no plural
entries.context: My internet is very slow today, cannot watch video on YouTube.

entries.vietlish: please send the file again, I not receive
entries.natural: please send the file again, I didn't receive it
entries.sourcePattern: toi khong nhan duoc -> negative without did, dropped object
entries.context: Please send the file again, I not receive your email.

entries.vietlish: the meeting is online or offline
entries.natural: is the meeting online or in person
entries.sourcePattern: truc tiep -> offline calqued for in person
entries.context: Please tell me, the meeting is online or offline tomorrow?

entries.vietlish: I will join the meeting by Zoom
entries.natural: I'll join the meeting on Zoom
entries.sourcePattern: qua Zoom -> by instead of on for a platform
entries.context: I am at home today, I will join the meeting by Zoom.

entries.vietlish: my account is hacked, cannot login
entries.natural: my account was hacked, I can't log in
entries.sourcePattern: bi hack -> be hacked for past passive plus dropped subject
entries.context: Help me, my account is hacked, cannot login since morning.

entries.vietlish: click to here to download
entries.natural: click here to download
entries.sourcePattern: bam vao day -> vao adds an extra to after click
entries.context: To get the form, click to here to download it.

entries.vietlish: I forgot save the file, lost all
entries.natural: I forgot to save the file and lost everything
entries.sourcePattern: quen luu -> forgot + base verb plus all for everything
entries.context: The power went out, I forgot save the file, lost all my work.

entries.vietlish: please on the air conditioner
entries.natural: please turn on the air conditioner
entries.sourcePattern: bat may lanh -> on used as a bare verb for switch on
entries.context: It is so hot, please on the air conditioner.

entries.vietlish: how much for one night here
entries.natural: how much is it for one night here
entries.sourcePattern: mot dem bao nhieu -> copula and dummy it dropped
entries.context: I need a room, how much for one night here?

entries.vietlish: I want to book a room for two night
entries.natural: I want to book a room for two nights
entries.sourcePattern: hai dem -> night without plural after a number
entries.context: I want to book a room for two night, with breakfast.

entries.vietlish: the hotel has free breakfast or not
entries.natural: does the hotel have free breakfast
entries.sourcePattern: khach san co an sang mien phi khong -> no do-support, A-not-A tag
entries.context: Before I book, the hotel has free breakfast or not?

entries.vietlish: can you give me discount if I buy many
entries.natural: can you give me a discount if I buy a lot
entries.sourcePattern: giam gia neu mua nhieu -> article dropped plus many without a noun
entries.context: Can you give me discount if I buy many shirts?

entries.vietlish: this is too expensive, can reduce a little
entries.natural: this is too expensive, can you lower it a little
entries.sourcePattern: bot mot chut -> reduce for lower, dropped subject and object
entries.context: This is too expensive, can reduce a little for me?

entries.vietlish: I want to change money to dollar
entries.natural: I want to change money into dollars
entries.sourcePattern: doi tien sang do -> to for into plus dollar no plural
entries.context: At the bank I want to change money to dollar.

entries.vietlish: do you have room more cheap
entries.natural: do you have a cheaper room
entries.sourcePattern: phong re hon -> more cheap plus adjective after noun
entries.context: This is over my budget, do you have room more cheap?

entries.vietlish: the flight is delay, I wait at gate
entries.natural: the flight is delayed, I'm waiting at the gate
entries.sourcePattern: chuyen bay bi tre -> adjective without -ed plus dropped article
entries.context: The flight is delay, I wait at gate for two hours now.

entries.vietlish: I have fever since two day
entries.natural: I've had a fever for two days
entries.sourcePattern: sot hai ngay -> since/for plus day without plural and no perfect
entries.context: Doctor, I have fever since two day and a headache.

entries.vietlish: my child cough a lot at night, cannot sleep
entries.natural: my child coughs a lot at night and can't sleep
entries.sourcePattern: ho nhieu -> no third-person -s plus dropped subject
entries.context: My child cough a lot at night, cannot sleep well.

entries.vietlish: the doctor say I need rest more
entries.natural: the doctor said I need more rest
entries.sourcePattern: bac si noi -> no past plus more placed after the noun
entries.context: The doctor say I need rest more and drink water.

entries.vietlish: I am sick stomach, maybe bad food
entries.natural: I have a stomachache, maybe from bad food
entries.sourcePattern: dau bung -> sick stomach calque plus dropped connector
entries.context: I am sick stomach, maybe bad food from last night.

entries.vietlish: take this medicine after meal
entries.natural: take this medicine after meals
entries.sourcePattern: sau bua an -> meal without plural in a general statement
entries.context: The pharmacist said take this medicine after meal.

entries.vietlish: my blood pressure is up today
entries.natural: my blood pressure is high today
entries.sourcePattern: huyet ap len -> up for high, calque of len
entries.context: I feel dizzy, my blood pressure is up today.

entries.vietlish: she fainted because too hot
entries.natural: she fainted because it was too hot
entries.sourcePattern: vi qua nong -> dummy subject and be dropped in the clause
entries.context: At the market she fainted because too hot at noon.

entries.vietlish: I want to check my health total
entries.natural: I want a full health check-up
entries.sourcePattern: kham tong quat -> total placed after noun, calque of tong quat
entries.context: Once a year I want to check my health total at the hospital.

entries.vietlish: he broke his leg play football
entries.natural: he broke his leg playing football
entries.sourcePattern: gay chan khi da bong -> base verb instead of -ing
entries.context: Last week he broke his leg play football with friends.

entries.vietlish: I am free after five, call me
entries.natural: I'm free after five, call me then
entries.sourcePattern: ranh sau nam gio -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for register
entries.context: I am free after five, call me when you finish work.

entries.vietlish: he earns money to feed the whole family
entries.natural: he earns money to support the whole family
entries.sourcePattern: nuoi ca gia dinh -> feed calqued for financially support

entries.vietlish: she is doing thin these days
entries.natural: she is getting thinner these days
entries.sourcePattern: gay di -> do/become for get with an adjective
entries.context: She works too hard, she is doing thin these days.

entries.vietlish: I will return back next week
entries.natural: I will return next week
entries.sourcePattern: tro ve lai -> back added redundantly after return
entries.context: I am going to Hue, I will return back next week.

entries.vietlish: he repeated again the question
entries.natural: he repeated the question
entries.sourcePattern: lap lai -> again added redundantly after repeat
entries.context: Because we were noisy, he repeated again the question.

entries.vietlish: please reply back to me soon
entries.natural: please reply to me soon
entries.sourcePattern: tra loi lai -> back added redundantly after reply
entries.context: I sent the form, please reply back to me soon.

entries.vietlish: my house is very near to the school

entries.vietlish: she is more beautiful than before very much

entries.vietlish: I cannot stand this noise more

entries.context: The soup tastes very salty, add water to make it lighter.

entries.vietlish: I am hungry stomach, let's eat
entries.natural: I'm hungry, let's eat
entries.sourcePattern: doi bung -> hungry stomach calque of doi bung
entries.context: It is past noon, I am hungry stomach, let's eat now.

entries.vietlish: he speaks English better and better
entries.natural: he speaks English better and better

entries.context: After one year abroad, he speaks English better and better.

entries.vietlish: she gave birth a baby girl
entries.natural: she gave birth to a baby girl
entries.sourcePattern: sinh mot be gai -> to dropped after give birth
entries.context: Last month she gave birth a baby girl, very cute.

entries.vietlish: I look for my phone everywhere but cannot find

entries.vietlish: he is afraid that he will fail again

entries.vietlish: she makes me to laugh every day

entries.vietlish: he is enough old to drive

entries.vietlish: I will try to call you back as soon possible
entries.natural: I'll try to call you back as soon as possible

entries.vietlish: she sells very cheap, many people buy

entries.vietlish: the children grow up very fast

entries.vietlish: I am interested in this job very much

entries.vietlish: he goes to work by walk

entries.vietlish: she always helps to her friends

entries.vietlish: I cannot wait to meet you, so exciting
entries.natural: I can't wait to meet you, it's so exciting

entries.context: We will see each other next week, I cannot wait to meet you, so exciting.

entries.vietlish: she is busy to take care of three kids
entries.natural: she is busy taking care of three kids
entries.sourcePattern: ban cham con -> to-infinitive instead of gerund after busy
entries.context: She has no free time, she is busy to take care of three kids.

entries.vietlish: I prefer to stay home than go out

entries.sourcePattern: thich o nha hon -> than instead of rather than after prefer to
entries.context: On rainy days I prefer to stay home than go out.

entries.vietlish: he drives very slow on purpose
entries.natural: he drives very slowly on purpose
entries.sourcePattern: chay cham -> adjective slow used as an adverb
entries.context: To save fuel, he drives very slow on purpose.

entries.vietlish: the rice cooker is broken, cannot use
entries.natural: the rice cooker is broken, I can't use it
entries.sourcePattern: khong dung duoc -> dropped subject and object after cannot use

entries.vietlish: she is the same height with her sister
entries.natural: she is the same height as her sister
entries.sourcePattern: cao bang -> with instead of as for same height
entries.context: People mix them up, she is the same height with her sister.

entries.vietlish: I bought it with a cheap price
entries.natural: I bought it at a cheap price
entries.sourcePattern: voi gia re -> with instead of at for price
entries.context: On sale day I bought it with a cheap price.

entries.vietlish: he works hard for earn money
entries.natural: he works hard to earn money
entries.sourcePattern: de kiem tien -> for + base verb instead of to of purpose
entries.context: Far from home, he works hard for earn money for his family.

entries.vietlish: the result makes me disappointing
entries.natural: the result makes me disappointed
entries.sourcePattern: that vong -> -ing participle for the affected person
entries.context: I studied hard, the result makes me disappointing.

entries.vietlish: please water on the plants tonight
entries.natural: please water the plants tonight
entries.sourcePattern: tuoi cay -> on inserted plus calque of tuoi
entries.context: I will be away, please water on the plants tonight.

entries.vietlish: she cuts the apple into four part
entries.natural: she cuts the apple into four parts
entries.sourcePattern: bon phan -> part without plural after a number
entries.context: For the children, she cuts the apple into four part.

entries.vietlish: he goes to bed very late, so always sleepy
entries.natural: he goes to bed very late, so he's always sleepy
entries.sourcePattern: nen luc nao cung buon ngu -> dropped subject and be after so
entries.context: He goes to bed very late, so always sleepy in class.

entries.vietlish: I am very thankful for your kindness
entries.natural: I'm very thankful for your kindness
entries.sourcePattern: rat biet on -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for register
entries.context: You helped me a lot, I am very thankful for your kindness.

entries.vietlish: they live very far, hard to visit
entries.natural: they live very far away, so it's hard to visit
entries.sourcePattern: kho tham -> dropped dummy subject and connector
entries.context: My grandparents they live very far, hard to visit often.

entries.vietlish: I want to say thank to everybody
entries.natural: I want to say thanks to everybody
entries.sourcePattern: noi cam on -> thank without -s in say thanks
entries.context: Before I leave, I want to say thank to everybody here.

entries.vietlish: she looks after very well the old man
entries.natural: she looks after the old man very well
entries.sourcePattern: cham soc tot -> adverb placed before the object
entries.context: The family trusts her, she looks after very well the old man.

entries.vietlish: we will meet again in some day
entries.natural: we'll meet again someday
entries.sourcePattern: mot ngay nao do -> in + some day for someday
entries.context: Goodbye for now, we will meet again in some day.

entries.vietlish: he speaks too small, I cannot hear
entries.natural: he speaks too quietly, I can't hear him
entries.sourcePattern: noi nho -> small for quiet plus dropped object
entries.context: On the phone he speaks too small, I cannot hear clearly.

entries.vietlish: please make the volume small
entries.natural: please turn the volume down
entries.sourcePattern: van nho lai -> make small for turn down
entries.context: The baby is sleeping, please make the volume small.

entries.vietlish: I am studying to become a teacher in the future
entries.natural: I'm studying to become a teacher in the future
entries.sourcePattern: trong tuong lai -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: I love children, I am studying to become a teacher in the future.

entries.vietlish: she has a good health
entries.natural: she is in good health
entries.sourcePattern: co suc khoe tot -> have a health for be in good health
entries.context: At eighty, she has a good health and walks every day.

entries.vietlish: the room is lacking of light
entries.natural: the room lacks light
entries.sourcePattern: thieu anh sang -> of inserted after lacking
entries.context: Open the curtain, the room is lacking of light.

entries.vietlish: he is suffering from a difficult time
entries.natural: he is going through a difficult time
entries.sourcePattern: trai qua kho khan -> suffer from for go through
entries.context: Please be gentle, he is suffering from a difficult time now.

entries.vietlish: I will inform to you when it is ready

entries.context: Leave your number, I will inform to you when it is ready.

entries.vietlish: she explained very clear for the class
entries.natural: she explained it very clearly to the class
entries.sourcePattern: giai thich ro cho -> adjective for adverb plus for instead of to
entries.context: Everyone understood, she explained very clear for the class.

entries.vietlish: I cannot afford to buy a house in this time

entries.sourcePattern: luc nay -> in instead of at for this time

entries.vietlish: the company gives us bonus in the end of year
entries.natural: the company gives us a bonus at the end of the year
entries.sourcePattern: cuoi nam -> in for at plus dropped articles
entries.context: I save money because the company gives us bonus in the end of year.

entries.vietlish: he is the head of the family, everybody listen him
entries.natural: he is the head of the family, and everybody listens to him
entries.sourcePattern: nghe loi -> listen without to plus no third-person -s
entries.context: In our home he is the head of the family, everybody listen him.

entries.vietlish: she married early, only nineteen years old

entries.context: In the village she married early, only nineteen years old.

entries.vietlish: I am late because the alarm not ring

entries.vietlish: we should keep the environment clean for next generation

entries.natural: she works as a waitress in a restaurant
entries.sourcePattern: phuc vu -> waiter used for both genders
entries.context: To pay for school, she works as a waiter in a restaurant.

entries.context: It was too tall, so I cut down the tree last weekend.

entries.vietlish: please remember bring your umbrella
entries.natural: please remember to bring your umbrella
entries.sourcePattern: nho mang theo -> remember + base verb without to
entries.context: It may rain, please remember bring your umbrella.

entries.vietlish: he runs a small shop near the market
entries.natural: he runs a small shop near the market
entries.sourcePattern: mo cua hang -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: After he retired, he runs a small shop near the market.

entries.vietlish: I will treat you a coffee tomorrow
entries.natural: I'll treat you to a coffee tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: moi ca phe -> to dropped after treat
entries.context: Thanks for your help, I will treat you a coffee tomorrow.
